name: MeshGraphNets: Learned Mesh-Based Simulation
summary: Predict evolving physical states on simulation meshes using graph-network message passing.
summary_zh: 在空间网格图上通过消息传递学习物理状态演化。
core_idea: Train graph networks over mesh connectivity for rollout predictions and adaptive mesh representation.
innovation: Provides learning-based physical simulation on irregular meshes, complementary to traditional discretizations.
limitations: Accumulated rollout error can harm long-term predictions.
Graph simulation does not automatically imply a mesh-independent neural operator.

start_here.focus: Graph representation, physical rollout and mesh adaptation.

curation_note: Representative publication checked; recommendations are advisory and application-specific clinical claims require separate evidence.
